description: Defines the class 'Image_Canvas_WithMap' which extends 'Image_Canvas' to handle image creation with support for HTML image maps, including methods for drawing shapes, adding text, overlaying images, and retrieving the image map.

classes.name: Image_Canvas_WithMap
classes.description: A class for handling different output formats including a HTML image map, extending 'Image_Canvas' with additional image map functionalities.

methods.name: Image_Canvas_WithMap
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the canvas and optionally creates an image map if 'usemap' parameter is true.

methods.name: line
methods.description: Draws a line on the canvas and image map.

methods.name: addVertex
methods.description: Adds a vertex to a polygon and to the image map.

methods.name: addSpline
methods.description: Adds a splined vertex to a polygon and to the image map.

methods.name: polygon
methods.description: Draws a polygon and adds it to the image map.

methods.name: rectangle
methods.description: Draws a rectangle and adds it to the image map.

methods.name: ellipse
methods.description: Draws an ellipse and adds it to the image map.

methods.name: pieslice
methods.description: Draws a pie slice and adds it to the image map.

methods.name: addText
methods.description: Writes text on the canvas and image map.

methods.name: image
methods.description: Overlays an image on the canvas and image map.

methods.name: getImageMap
methods.description: Returns the image map object if available.
